evals.prompt: 我是 SRE 团队的，在群 oc_sre_oncall 里。帮我每 5 分钟检查一下 K8s Pod 状态，有问题再告诉我就行。我的 agent_id 是 agent-sre-001。
evals.expected_output: Agent should generate a `temporal schedule create` command with: schedule ID following sched-{desc}-{nn} format, cron */5 * * * *, notify_rule=on_error, all memo fields populated, HEARTBEAT_OK injected into task_prompt

assertions.name: schedule_id_format
assertions.check: Schedule ID follows sched-{description}-{number} naming convention

assertions.name: notify_rule_on_error
assertions.check: notify_rule is set to on_error (user said '有问题再告诉我')

assertions.name: memo_fields_complete
assertions.check: All 5 memo fields present: chat_id, agent_id, task_prompt, notify_rule, source

evals.prompt: 我在 oc_data_team 群，agent_id 是 agent-data-002。帮我设一个每天早上 9 点发昨日系统运行报告的定时任务。
evals.expected_output: Agent should generate a `temporal schedule create` command with: cron 0 9 * * *, notify_rule=always, all memo fields, proper schedule ID

assertions.name: notify_rule_always
assertions.check: notify_rule is set to always (user wants daily report pushed)

assertions.name: memo_fields_complete
assertions.check: All 5 memo fields present: chat_id, agent_id, task_prompt, notify_rule, source

assertions.name: schedule_id_format
assertions.check: Schedule ID follows sched-{description}-{number} naming convention

evals.prompt: 我在群 oc_sre_oncall，帮我看看这个群里有哪些定时任务？然后把 Pod 巡检那个删掉，不需要了。
evals.expected_output: Agent should: 1) use temporal schedule list + jq to filter by chat_id=oc_sre_oncall, 2) ask for user confirmation before deleting, 3) use temporal schedule delete with the correct schedule-id

assertions.name: list_with_chat_id_filter
assertions.check: Uses temporal schedule list --output json with jq filtering by chat_id

assertions.name: deletion_confirmation
assertions.check: Asks for user confirmation before executing delete

assertions.name: delete_command_correct
assertions.check: Uses temporal schedule delete --schedule-id with the correct ID
